'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Mark Walrath LS Credits Will Do Fine''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walrath]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title Credits.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Walrath]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Credits Will Do Fine / A Valuable Asset|Credits Will Do Fine]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
